title: Synchronized public launch campaign & release-note coordination
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Coordinate a single, coherent external announcement for console-2026.03 that combines consolidated release notes, a feature blog post, targeted customer emails, social amplification, and a product webinar. The goal is to present a unified message across channels so users understand the performance, reliability, and pricing changes in the new release and to drive adoption of Dedicated/Private features.

Scope:
- Finalize release notes (user-facing, upgrade notes, breaking changes) and get sign-off from Engineering, Legal, and Support.
- Produce a long-form launch blog focused on performance and migration path for Dedicated/Private customers.
- Create three email flows: (1) existing customers with Dedicated/Private, (2) freemium users with feature highlights, (3) partner outreach.
- Assemble social asset pack (X/Twitter threads, LinkedIn post, short demo video clip).
- Run a webinar (product walkthrough + live Q&A) within one week of announcement.
- Coordinate tracking (UTMs, feature flags to gate announcement, telemetry events) and support readiness (playbook + triage channel).

Success metrics (first 30 days):
- 15% uplift in console sign-ins from email cohort,
- Webinar attendance >= 300 and NPS >= 70,
- 95% of release-note recipients report no upgrade blockers via support tickets,
- 10% increase in Dedicated trial conversions from targeted customers.

Links and artifacts: PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PRD/console-2026.03-launch (draft) | Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/console-2026.03 (editable) | Blog draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/blog-drafts/2026-03-console-performance | Webinar deck (v0): https://drive.google.com/drive/folder/webinar-console-2026
acceptance_criteria: Release notes published to docs.redwood.ai and reviewed by Eng/Legal/Support
Blog post scheduled with marketing (publish date aligned with email send)
Three email flows written, approved, and scheduled in SendGrid / Customer.io
Social asset pack uploaded to Marketing assets with copy and image/video files
Webinar event scheduled with registration page, speaker slate, and rehearsals planned
Support playbook created and an on-call rotation assigned for D+3 window
Tracking (UTM + telemetry) validated in staging and smoke-tested against test events
checklist: Draft release notes (PM) -> ENG technical review
Legal copy review for blog and emails
Design for hero image and short demo video
Set up webinar registration + rehearsal booking
Create social cadence and paid amplification plan
Define rollback and incident playbook with SRE
Tag features in telemetry and validate dashboards

risks: Last-minute engineering bug delaying publish of docs or causing migration blockers
Legal requests for wording changes that push timeline
Low webinar registration due to short notice or competing events
Analytics tagging failure preventing cohort measurement
mitigation_plan: Feature flag announcement in docs so we can gate public visibility if a blocker appears
Block time with Legal for rapid turnaround; contingency copy prepared
Paid social boost budget reserved to drive registrations if organic falls short
Validation checklist for analytics with a dry-run on staging two days before publish
